name: bring down a digit and subtract the largest fitting multiple
mechanism: from the most significant end, append the next digit of the dividend to the partial remainder, find the largest single digit whose multiple of the divisor fits, emit that digit and subtract; the remainder carries to the next position

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Long division' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions:

requires: comparison and subtraction on the partial remainder
fails_when: one digit per step; quadratic in length
